scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns finite simple connected complete multipartite graphs. The all-set classification is proved symbolically; exhaustive verification through order \(9\) is only a finite consistency check. The 2019 paper introducing the doubly connected domination polynomial was not available in complete lawful full text during this check; its abstract names friendship and cactus-chain families rather than arbitrary complete multipartite graphs. The 2024 complete-multipartite scalar theorem was inspected and is treated as prior coverage of the minimum-cardinality consequence.
title: Doubly connected dominating sets of complete multipartite graphs
